title: What to bring
body:
Full club kit — top, shorts, socks. Boots and a pair of trainers for indoor sessions.

A charged phone, and a bottle of water.

If you need replacement kit, ask in the group and we will sort it.

title: Getting there
body:
Check the Venues page for parking, where to meet and any gate codes.

Aim to be on site 15 minutes before your session starts. For a first visit at a new site, make it 20.

title: Who you are working with
body:
Most sessions run with two coaches. The Schedule page shows who else is on yours.

If you are ever unsure who is leading, it is the coach named first.

title: If you are running late or ill
body:
Call the office as early as you can on 01234 567890. A text is fine out of hours, but call if it is the same day.

- Never cancel directly with a school
- Let the group know so cover can be arranged
- Email office@example.co.uk if it is not urgent

title: Safeguarding
body:
If anything concerns you, report it the same day. Do not wait until the next session and do not discuss it with parents.

Call the office, and follow up in writing so there is a record.

title: What a good session looks like
body:
Everyone is active within two minutes of arriving. No queues.

Every player gets spoken to by name at least once.

You finish on time and the pitch is left as you found it.

title: Invoicing
body:
Invoices go in by the last day of the month. Include the dates, the sites and the hours.

Anything submitted after the 3rd waits for the following month.

title: Holiday and cover
body:
Give as much notice as you can — a fortnight where possible.

Cover is arranged by the office, not between coaches directly.
